task.title: To set a style for a segment in a template
task.shortdesc: Maanasa Suthrave In the X-Author Templates pane, go to the Work tab, click the more

step.cmd: In the X-Author Templates pane, go to the Work tab, click the more options icon () and select Set Segment.
Highlight a block of text in your template and click Set Style. This opens the Select Styles window that lists custom styles.
Select a custom style or select the Show built-in styles checkbox and select a style.
Click Select. The segment is added as Segment Regular to the segments list in the Set Segment pane. Selecting the segment name from the list highlights that segment in the template document.

To view or edit a segment style:Select Segment Regular from the segments list in the Set Segments pane and click the gear icon () next to the segment name. This opens the Segment Regular page with the segment style set for that segment. To edit the style, click the pencil icon () next to Style.

substep.cmd: Select Segment Regular from the segments list in the Set Segments pane and click the gear icon () next to the segment name. This opens the Segment Regular page with the segment style set for that segment.
To edit the style, click the pencil icon () next to Style.

step.cmd: To add a segment condition, click Add Condition. This opens the Make Conditional window which has the expression builder. For more information, see To make a Segment Conditional in a template. Segment Regular style segment changes to Segment Conditional after you add a condition. When you generate a document using a template with style segments, you can view different styles applied in the generated document.
